cluster: unimatrix (Slurm, partition debug; nodes node002-node005; node007 excluded: no java; node008 excluded: /data not mounted)

phenotype_data.contents_used: 2512_phenotype.mv.db (2025-11-06), rw_string_10.mv, hp.obo (hp/releases/2025-05-06); phenix/ subdirectory not unpacked (Phenix prioritiser not used)
phenotype_data.note: no sha256 file is published for 2512; hash computed locally

genome_data.why: Exomiser 15.1.0 CLI refuses to start without a configured genome assembly ('No GenomeAnalysisService instance provided! You must specify at least one exomiser genome assembly data version in the application.properties file.'). No VCF is given, so no variant data are used; the hg19 Ensembl transcript set defines the enumerated gene set (34,829 genes).

exomiser.mode: phenotype-only: official preset examples/preset-phenotype-only-analysis.yml (docs: PHENOTYPE_ONLY preset), steps omimPrioritiser + hiPhivePrioritiser, empty inheritanceModes, no VCF

configs.hiphive_default: jobs/tool_restriction/exomiser_hiphive_default.yml = preset-phenotype-only-analysis.yml unchanged (hiPhive human, mouse, fish, PPI)

exomiser.sample_format: v1 phenopacket YAML: id, subject.id, phenotypicFeatures[].type.id, metaData.phenopacketSchemaVersion 1.0 (no sex/age)
exomiser.score: genePhenotypeScore from the PARQUET output (equals EXOMISER_GENE_PHENO_SCORE of TSV_GENE, checked to 5e-5 on one analysis; INFERRED, not verified: it is the combined priority score of the OMIM and hiPhive prioritisers). PARQUET lists only genes with score > 0; TSV_GENE lists all 34,829 genes (rest score 0).
exomiser.universe_definition: all genes in a phenotype-only TSV_GENE output (hg19 2512 Ensembl gene set enumerated by Exomiser without a VCF); 26,407 have an NCBI Gene id. n_scored = genes with phenotype score > 0; causative gene with score 0 gets absent=1 and the midrank of the zero block.
exomiser.python_reader: pyarrow 17.0.0 installed with pip --target /data/hohndor/pavs-tools/pylib (PYTHONPATH), used with /data/hohndor/pavs-popmodel/venv/bin/python (numpy 1.26.4)

lirical.mode: phenotype-only: `prioritize` without --vcf and without --assembly (CLI help: 'Leave unset to run in phenotype-only mode'); defaults otherwise (OMIM diseases, no Orphanet, no negated terms, sex UNKNOWN, no age)
lirical.command: java -Xmx2g -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1 -XX:+UseSerialGC -Djava.io.tmpdir=$WORK -jar lirical-cli-2.4.2.jar prioritize -d data -p HP:...,HP:... -o $WORK -x l{k}_{profile} -f json --sample-id l{k}_{profile}
lirical.gene_score: max posttestProbability (JSON, full precision) over the diseases linked to the gene by LIRICAL's own data/mim2gene_medgen (type=phenotype rows with a GeneID; the file LIRICAL loads via phenol Mim2GeneMedgenLoader); NCBI Gene id -> symbol via data/hgnc_complete_set.txt
lirical.universe_definition: NCBI Gene ids linked by data/mim2gene_medgen (type=phenotype, GeneID present) to an OMIM disease in data/phenotype.hpoa; all are scored in every run (n_scored = 4961)

profiles: export_profiles.py over results/fine2/cases_{store,pmcp_map2,abs}.tsv, hpo/ (hp.obo 2026-01-08), results/termclass.jsonl; same code path and seeded draw as gda_impact.py rank --random-control

slurm.pilot: LIRICAL 12196 (array 0-5, 1 cpu, 4G), Exomiser 12211 (array 0-5, 2 cpu, 16G, -Xmx12g); 60 cases (10 per region, first 10 by sha1(id))
slurm.full: Exomiser 12218 (--array=0-149%40 -c 2 --mem=16G, -Xmx12g, sub-batches of 50 cases per JVM); LIRICAL 12219 (--array=0-299%110 -c 1 --mem=3G, -Xmx2g; time limit lowered from 12h to 3h after submission so that backfill would start it)
